history.name: Exporting the whole ledger
history.description: The command ledger export prints the entire corpus as a single JSON document: the release timeline, the areas, the sub-sections, the product-wide changes, and every feature with its full history. It writes to a file instead when you name one, for a backup, a migration, or handing the data to something that isn't this tool.
history.dev_notes: src/commands/read.mjs cmdExport, schema_version 1. Wired into the CLI but absent from `ledger --help`.
